# The same as `fx_usd_bill_settled_from_an_hkd_bank.txt`, with `notes:` on the
# bill — which the shipped release filed in the slot beside the object rather
# than on the field the comparison reads.
#
# That combination is what makes the migration bite: the comparison answers
# "different" every run, a posted bill judged different is rebuilt, rebuilding
# unposts it, and unposting a bill whose settlement drew a cost basis down is
# refused. Neither half alone reaches it.
#
# The payable side of the same shape: a USD bill paid out of an HKD bank, in
# a CAD-base book. The signs invert — a payable is settled by a debit and the
# cash goes out — and the realized difference is measured the same way, what
# the payable was booked at against what the cash was worth.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

vendor "V-US"
	name: "US Vendor"
	currency: USD

bill "BILL-USD-FROM-HKD"
	notes: "Parts for the March build"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		action: "Materials"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-FROM-HKD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		settled_amount: 780.00
		memo: "Payment for BILL-USD-FROM-HKD"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
